name: Jameson Davies
bio:
Jameson Davies found his way into motorsport through a less conventional route than most. Originally trained as a mechanical engineer, he worked for a large automotive manufacturer before realizing his true passion lay in the high-octane world of racing. He started as a volunteer mechanic at a local track, quickly impressing people with his meticulous attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.

At Caterham Motorsport, Jameson excels at coordinating test drivers, ensuring their feedback is accurately captured and translated into tangible improvements for the car. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to get the best out of his team. He believes in fostering open communication and a collaborative environment, where everyone feels comfortable sharing their insights. His colleagues appreciate his data-driven approach and creative solutions.

physical.description: Jameson is of average height with a sturdy build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on brewing his own coffee every morning using a portable espresso machine.
